decisions.reason: The combined shuttering/de-shuttering robot embodies the firm's publicly announced automation strategy and has absorbed substantial in-house R&D, so management will persist and attribute any slow uptake to the temporary construction downturn.
The de-shuttering robot is a core module of the firm's automated plant offering, so sunk engineering costs and its visible market commitment favor keeping it despite cyclical demand weakness.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots in integrated lines, and its recent launch means disappointing results would be blamed on market timing rather than prompting withdrawal.
The automatic shuttering robot is central to the firm's future-ready precast automation narrative and long investment cycles, so management remains committed to it.
